name: Bloody Mist Legacy: Frost bound Shield

system.description:
Bulwark: Ice Mirrors that you summon gains additional hit points equal to your level.

Stalwart: You gain a rank of Mastery to Strength and Dexterity saving throws while occupying an Ice Mirror. This increases to two ranks at 11th level. Additionally, Ice Mirrors you summon are resistant to damage that affects an area.

Black Frost: When you inflict the Frostbite condition, all of your active Ice Mirrors regain 5 hit point.
